assessment_objectives.objective: a documented data privacy accountability structure exists.

the data privacy accountability structure identifies the data privacy roles required by applicable statutory, regulatory and/or contractual obligations (e.g., Data Protection Officer (DPO), representative in a jurisdiction, data owner).
each identified data privacy role is assigned to one or more named individuals.
individuals assigned to data privacy roles possess the requisite qualifications for the role.
individuals assigned to data privacy roles are granted the authority, independence and resources needed to perform the role.
the data privacy accountability structure is reviewed and updated when data privacy obligations, operating jurisdictions and/or business practices change.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually, and upon change to applicable data privacy obligations, operating jurisdictions or business practices
